name: io.github.cyuanxv/telegram-bot-mcp-server
title: Telegram Bot MCP Server
description: Self-hosted Telegram Bot MCP server for rich text, media and interactive buttons.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by the same MCP_API_KEY configured for the local server.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your own default Telegram chat ID.
